title: Documentation verification
heading: Failures and corrections
text: Failures and corrections Finding or failed attempt Correction and lesson --- --- Old checks covered only 11 HTML pages and omitted newer Markdown features Scan the maintained Markdown corpus and derive public navigation/search from one manifest Stale Node 18 instructions and browser/TUI confusion Align Node requirements with package engines and give each interface an explicit guide First screenshot fixture passed the wrong queue-create argument shape Use the actual queue API signature and inspect the resulting queue before capture Browser captures contained JPEG data under PNG names Use correct extensions, validate headers, and record hashes/dimensions Some navigation capture attempts did not reach the requested screen Discard mismatched images and verify the actual heading before naming a capture First build after adding a page/metadata made the catalog stale Include manifest-declared outputs before they exist; build then check now passes deterministically Draft feature map named nonexistent verifiers Trace references to actual source/test files before treating the map as current Named-queue syntax was incorrectly described as a top-level CLI capability Separate top-level CLI help from browser/terminal console commands and generate both references Draft ER cardinality implied every task had a plan and every plan had an imported issue Make those references optional and distinguish task sessions from shared planning calls Headless Escape test failed, then still timed out after waiting for closure Fix explicit Escape handling while the search input has focus; verify close and focus restoration in Chrome and the regression The failed browser attempt remains recorded even though the final run passed. The useful lesson is to verify the full reader interaction, not only the page's ability to render.

title: Documentation verification
heading: Retrievability and editorial review
text: Retrievability and editorial review Chrome search found the intended guide for Jira , Azure , queue , Ask ATL , model , resource policy , and lifecycle . Empty search results show a recovery message. Shared navigation and page outlines provide alternative entry points. New workflow guides were reviewed for audience, purpose, correctness, prerequisites, procedure, expected outcome, recovery, traceability, discoverability, and maintenance ownership. Editorial score: 19/20 , with traceability 1/2 because the source boundary includes an uncommitted overlay; the other dimensions scored 2/2 . This is an editorial assessment, not a correctness proof.

title: Documentation verification
heading: Remaining limits and maintenance
text: Remaining limits and maintenance Version 0.1.3 publication preflight The release candidate combines these guides with the runtime and synthetic verifiers they describe. Local manager state, credentials, private run artifacts, and machine-specific config/manager.json changes are excluded from the commit. The repository's committed configuration is used for the release checks. The October 29 publication regression first passed 90 of 92 checks. The source-intake browser test exposed a late settings response replacing an editable form; loading now completes before showing the form, and background snapshot/stream updates preserve unsaved source inputs. A regression explicitly checks preservation after focus leaves the field. The documentation clipboard assertion also ran before its asynchronous operation completed; it now waits for the observed copied state. Both original failures remain recorded under .atl-evidence/mock-regression/ locally. Publication status must be checked in GitHub Actions and the package registry; this local record does not predict a remote result. - Pages and package workflows were updated locally; no push, release, remote CI run, package publication, or Pages deployment was performed. - External links were not checked live. Installed provider protocol compatibility, real model quality, production connector access, and production delivery were not tested by this documentation refresh. - The browser checks cover documentation behavior; they do not replace the runtime's feature verifiers or the earlier recorded mock E2E exercise. - The full site is English. The Persian entry guide is refreshed and links to canonical English procedures. Edit Markdown and the page manifest, regenerate, run static and browser checks, then advance docs/sync.yml . Follow [documentation workflow](documentation.md) and [development](development.md). A future source change must invalidate or update the affected claims before this record is reused as current evidence.
